name: saucedemo-automation
description: SauceDemo e-commerce automation with POM, Cucumber hooks, and Allure reports

scripts.test: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:cucumber
scripts.test:allure: npm run allure:clean && npm run test:e2e && npm run allure:generate
scripts.allure:clean: node -e "['allure-results','allure-report'].forEach((d) => require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }))"
